March 4, 1993
Re: Petition for Public Records Disclosure Order
OHSU Hospital Records
Dear Mr. Osmundson:
THOMAS A. BALMER
DEPUTY ATTORNEY CENERAI
This letter is the Attorney General's order on your petition for disclosure of
records under the Oregon Public Records Law, ORS 192.410 to 192.505. Your
petition, which we received on February 26, 1993, asks the Attorney General to direct
OHSU Hospital to provide your physician at Kaiser HMO Cascade Park, Washington,
a copy of your medical records.
Records at OHSU indicate that by letter dated December 28, 1992, you made a
request (and provided a release) to have your medical records provided to the Kaiser
Sunnyside Hospital. That letter was logged in at the Medical Correspondence
Division of Medical Records, OHSU University Hospital, on December 29, 1992.
That office's records show your medical records were mailed to the Kaiser Sunnyside
Hospital on January 5, 1993. OHSU has no other record of any other request by you
for records.
Because you have not been denied access to the records, the Attorney General
lacks authority to order disclosure. ~ ORS 192.450(1).
Jim Osmundson
Page 2
March 4, 1993
Given the additional information you provided in your letter of February 23,
1993, to the Attorney General, the Medical Correspondence Division of Medical
Records, OHSU Hospital, advises us that another copy of your medical records will
be provided to your doctor at Kaiser HMO Cascade Park, Washington.
Sincerely,
~__/.~
ELIZABETH S. HARCHENKO
Special Counsel to the Attorney General
